authority.purpose: Design a conservative multi-tranche route toward the D1 development minimum while reducing measured language and domain concentration.

currentState.imbalanceDecision: SEVERE_CONCENTRATION; additional Python/software-documentation acquisition is low priority and may not be used as a scale shortcut.

planningSemantics.acceptedTokenEquivalentCapacity: A pre-acquisition planning estimate after applying a frozen conservative loss reserve; it is not an accepted-token count.
planningSemantics.checkpointRule: Each tranche must complete the full quality pipeline and obtain an exact accepted-token measurement before the next tranche source/volume authorization is frozen.

tranches.exitCheckpoint: Measure actual accepted tokens, full language/domain composition, realized loss rates, per-source compression, duplicate/contamination losses, and rights exceptions before B authorization.
Recompute exact deficit to 53,310,208 after aggregate deduplication and tokenizer measurement; freeze C source identities and capacities from measured A/B yields only.

tranches.goal: Cross 53,310,208 aggregate accepted tokens after all losses with a minimum 1,000,000-token planning buffer.
tranches.allocationRule: Use only rights-cleared, validated source classes that reduce the measured post-B language/domain gaps. No source substitution; if projected conservative yield cannot cross the minimum plus buffer, fail closed and issue a revised plan.
tranches.sourcePortfolio: Not frozen until A/B checkpoint evidence; candidates must come from the source register below and separately pass rights/allowlist authorization.
tranches.exitCheckpoint: Complete aggregate pipeline and exact count. Crossing the scale minimum does not authorize training.

sourceRegister.provider: U.S. Government Publishing Office / Office of the Law Revision Counsel
sourceRegister.expectedRawScale: bounded by ceiling; no size claim
sourceRegister.estimatedAcceptedTokenEquivalentCapacity: 1–4M only as portfolio planning range; must be measured
sourceRegister.rightsBasis: U.S. Government works generally public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105; transferred-copyright/package notices remain controlling
sourceRegister.redistributionTrainingUse: Only packages without contrary notice; retain GPO/OLRC provenance and qualifications
sourceRegister.access: explicit HTTPS XML/ZIP package URLs from a pre-frozen title allowlist
sourceRegister.extraction: secure archive validation then deterministic XML section extraction
sourceRegister.contaminationRisk: historical legal benchmarks and quoted material; mandatory frozen reference screening
sourceRegister.duplicateRisk: revisions, repeated definitions, boilerplate, cross-title references; high

sourceRegister.duplicateRisk: catalog mirrors, repeated templates, editions; high

sourceRegister.robotsConstraints: no crawling or endpoint discovery during execution

storageAndManifestArchitecture.directoryRule: One new immutable D1-DATA-RAW-EXPANSION-{A|B|C}-<UTC> directory per separately authorized tranche; never overwrite D1-DATA-RAW-001.
storageAndManifestArchitecture.failureEvidence: Partial, oversized, wrong-type, redirect, challenge, or error payloads remain immutable unpromoted failure evidence and are excluded from all candidate counts.

aggregatePipeline: aggregate exact deduplication against existing candidate by manifest/hash

immutableCorpusStrategy.futureAggregateRule: Create a new versioned aggregate root and manifest referencing the existing candidate and each new tranche by immutable manifest/hash; copy/link policy must never rewrite predecessor payloads.

splitDecision.reason: Splitting before expanded aggregate deduplication and contamination analysis risks cross-split near-duplicate leakage and repeated resealing.
